priorityList: Cast Power Infusion, ideally coinciding with your main burst window.
Cast Voidform (or Dark Ascension) if your damage-over-time effects are active on the target.
Cast Void Torrent on cooldown to trigger and sustain your Entropic Rift.
Prioritize Void Blast above all else while Entropic Rift is active.
Cast Shadow Word: Madness if you are near maximum Insanity, have a Mind Devourer proc, or during Entropic Rift.
Use Tentacle Slam to refresh Vampiric Touch or if you are about to cap charges.
Cast Shadow Word: Death on targets below 20% health or to trigger Devour Matter.
Cast Mind Blast to generate Insanity and avoid capping charges.
Use Mind Flay: Insanity when available as your high-priority filler.
Manually apply or refresh Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain if they are not active and Tentacle Slam is unavailable.
Use Mind Flay as your standard filler when all other abilities are on cooldown.
